title: Croatian Spinach Casserole
description: A hearty, comforting dish featuring layers of spinach, umami flavors, and a dense casserole crust. Perfect for a cozy dinner.

ingredients.name: Casserole
ingredients.notes: Make your own or use store-bought

instructions: In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat.
Add chopped spinach and cook until wilted.
Stir in umami paste (if using) and season with salt and pepper.
In a separate bowl, mix casserole crumbs and feta cheese (if using).
In a greased 9x13-inch baking dish, create a layer of casserole crumbs.
Repeat layers one more time, ending with a layer of casserole crumbs.
Brush top crust with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until casserole crust is golden brown.
